text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Believing that a victory at the Takarazuka Kinen will motivate her hospitalized father in his recovery, Tamamo Cross is determined to win. But another competitor stands between her and first place…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The racer in question is Inari One, an Edo girl from Oi. Although they ran in different races, she was a regional runner like Oguri Cap. Now, a showdown between Kanto and Kansai competitors is about to kick off.
